   }

     return {"ok": false, "value": null, "error": message}
   }
   fn is_ok(result: map): bool { return result["ok"] == true }

       else { result[key] = result[key] + [elem] }
     }

   fn memoize(fn: fn(any)->any): fn(any)->any {
     let cache = {}
     return fn(arg: any) {
       let key = "" + arg
       if cache[key] != null { return cache[key] }
       let result = fn(arg)
       cache[key] = result
       return result
